content_data.meeting_title: Coastal Routes Rebranding Initiative: Visual Identity Review
agenda_items: Timeline and next steps for creative asset development
Integration strategy for new visual elements into existing digital platforms
Discussion on color palette and typography choices for primary marketing assets
key_decisions: Selected 'Ocean Sans' for primary headings and 'Voyage Serif' for body text due to their legibility and evocative feel.
Finalized the 'Wave Crest' logo variant for its dynamic representation of travel and regional focus.
action_items: Research and propose stock photography options that align with the new brand aesthetic - Owner: Junior Designer; Due: +7 days
Refine selected logo variant (Wave Crest) with minor adjustments to line weight - Owner: Creative Lead; Due: +5 days
Develop initial mock-ups for key digital touchpoints (website homepage, social media banners) using new visual identity - Owner: Design Team; Due: +10 days
Prepare presentation for client review of brand guidelines and initial asset mock-ups - Owner: Creative Director; Due: +14 days
